name: @b2b-saas-starter-kit/source
description: Nx monorepo starter for multi-tenant B2B SaaS — NestJS API and worker, React web/admin, Postgres, Redis, and Docker Compose staging.

scripts.infra:up: docker compose --project-directory . --env-file infra/env/.env -f infra/compose/docker-compose.yml -f infra/compose/docker-compose.override.yml up -d
scripts.infra:down: docker compose --project-directory . --env-file infra/env/.env -f infra/compose/docker-compose.yml -f infra/compose/docker-compose.override.yml down
scripts.infra:reset: docker compose --project-directory . --env-file infra/env/.env -f infra/compose/docker-compose.yml -f infra/compose/docker-compose.override.yml down --volumes && docker compose --project-directory . --env-file infra/env/.env -f infra/compose/docker-compose.yml -f infra/compose/docker-compose.override.yml up -d
scripts.infra:logs: docker compose --project-directory . --env-file infra/env/.env -f infra/compose/docker-compose.yml -f infra/compose/docker-compose.override.yml logs -f
scripts.infra:staging:up: docker compose --project-directory . --env-file infra/env/.env -f infra/compose/docker-compose.yml -f infra/compose/docker-compose.staging.yml up -d --build
scripts.infra:staging:down: JWT_ACCESS_SECRET="${JWT_ACCESS_SECRET:-unused}" docker compose --project-directory . --env-file infra/env/.env -f infra/compose/docker-compose.yml -f infra/compose/docker-compose.staging.yml down
scripts.infra:apps:up: docker compose --project-directory . --env-file infra/env/.env -f infra/compose/docker-compose.yml -f infra/compose/docker-compose.override.yml -f infra/compose/docker-compose.apps.yml --profile apps up -d --build
scripts.infra:apps:down: docker compose --project-directory . --env-file infra/env/.env -f infra/compose/docker-compose.yml -f infra/compose/docker-compose.override.yml -f infra/compose/docker-compose.apps.yml --profile apps down
scripts.infra:migrate: docker compose --project-directory . --env-file infra/env/.env -f infra/compose/docker-compose.yml -f infra/compose/docker-compose.staging.yml --profile migrate run --rm migrate
